scope: 50 additional editorial selections for Güncel Dünya Yıldızları; active professional players rather than an official greatness or popularity ranking.
nationalKits: Country labels identify the national association. Pixel kit colours and numbers are symbolic and do not assert a current club, current national squad membership or an exact 2026 uniform.
positionTags: FV/OF/DF/KL are broad game groups. Versatile players such as Arda Güler, Joshua Kimmich and Dani Olmo are grouped by their familiar club role; the game does not require every tournament's position wording to match.
availability: Active includes professionals recovering from injury; it does not claim the player is fit or was selected for the 2026 World Cup. Non-tournament players are supported separately by current official club or UEFA records.
artwork: 50 original local 96×96 static SVG pixel portraits. No remote photographs, trademarked logos or image downloads.

sources.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 official squad lists, 19 July 2026 version
sources.note: National association, name and professional team registration in the official 2026 tournament list. Club strings are deliberately not imported into game cards.
